title: Summing an Encoded List
statement: For every finite list $L$ of natural numbers and every $a\in\mathbb N$, applying the sum update $|L|$ times to the pairing of the binary representation of $a$ with the encoded list of binary representations of the entries of $L$ yields the pairing of the binary representation of $a+\sum_{n\in L}n$ with the empty bit string.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of natural numbers
